name: low-code-automation-testing-platform
description: Unified Enterprise Low-Code Automation & Deterministic Testing Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --prefix "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start:api" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k --prefix "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start:prod:api" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
